mixed_soil.basis: Mixed mineral soil; ordinary grass does not add a chemical bonus

rooted_soil.basis: Same physical profile as soil, with residual root fibre

chemical.basis: Residual roots/wood fibres, not a richer mineral assay

clayey_soil.basis: Clay-rich earthen soil; four clay balls represent one block

loam.basis: Mixed clay/sand/silt loam; alternate native ingredients do not change the output identity

regolith.basis: Conservative common output for arbitrary-regolith reidentification; no rock-specific chemical enrichment

red_sand.basis: Loose red sand; no recovered metallic pigment

pink_sand.basis: Loose pink sand; retained installed bulk identity

gravel.basis: Loose aggregate; generic crushing/milling alternatives remain native

carbonate.basis: Carbonate rock represented by installed calcite and aggregate

chemical.basis: Residual marine salts in porous marine carbonate

felsic.basis: Quartz-bearing felsic rock; mixed-rock quartz capped at 1/16

mafic.basis: Mixed silicate aggregate; no free metallic elements

conglomerate.basis: Coarse aggregate with dirt matrix; preserve native synthesis

obsidian.basis: Volcanic glass; retain existing useful powdered product, no new intermediate

chemical.basis: Nitrate-bearing cave guano; no precious or metallic recovery

guanostone.basis: Lithified guano; same nitrate cap after native guano smelting
